$comment: Test set for the AI port. Each case: <name>.txt (input text), <name>.response.json (the mock's answer),
<name>.expected.json (what pnpm eval:ai checks), optionally <name>.jsonld.json (JSON-LD sent with the text)
and <name>.png (the same recipe as an image). 'default' is the mock's answer for unknown input.
'reserved' inputs make the mock fail with that error code, for tests of the error messages.
koket-* and tasteline-* are the saved pages in tests/fixtures/sites/ as the import flow reads them (extractRecipePage); extract.test.ts keeps them in step.
